versions.subject: New experimental rule designed to find process injection
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\msra.exe' 
    ParentCommandLine: 'msra.exe'
    Image|endswith:
        - 'arp.exe'
        - 'cmd.exe'
        - 'net.exe'
        - 'netstat.exe'
        - 'nslookup.exe'
        - 'route.exe'
        - 'schtasks.exe'
        - 'whoami.exe'
condition: selection
